overview: At half past five the book was open at the feast, held by the pounce-box. You were coatless. A bluebottle was at the casement. You did not copy a line from the leaf onto the sheet.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the leaf as texture, and did not copy it.

assets.name: Brooke
assets.disposition: Opened the book at the feast

summary: Opened the book at the feast
